content.summary: Public health lecturer and researcher with 9 years of experience in maternal health programme evaluation, mixed-methods research, curriculum design, and peer-reviewed publication support.

experience.title: Senior Lecturer
bullets: Developed epidemiology modules for 180 annual undergraduate students, increasing course completion to 94%.
Led mixed-methods evaluation of maternal-health outreach across 32 facilities, informing three district action plans.
Supervised 18 dissertation projects using ethics-approved data collection and reproducible analysis protocols.

experience.title: Research Fellow
bullets: Conducted household survey analysis for a 4,800-participant immunisation study.
Authored evidence briefs that supported programme decisions in four regional health teams.

education.credential: Doctor of Philosophy in Public Health — demonstration

certifications.name: Research Ethics and Good Clinical Practice — demonstration
